Murmur.publicNotes:
Monstrous humanoids that resemble humans with snakes instead of hair, medusas are best known for their petrifying gazes that-if lingered upon-can permanently transform mortals to stone. Medusas are shrewd and manipulative adversaries who collect and covet secrets, and who use threats and guile to exploit the fears of weaker creatures. A medusa may seek out powerful magic items, use divination magic to discover secret knowledge and unlock forbidden power, or infiltrate a society to beguile influential politicians. Their ability to worm their way into powerful organizations makes them natural leaders of criminal outfits and thieves' guilds, and their interest in magical phenomena leads some to pursue careers as oracles who offer to help adventurers find what they seek-for a price. Of course, if wit and deception proves insufficient, a medusa can always simply turn rivals into ornate stone decorations with little more than a glare.

Exceptionally agile and surprisingly hardy, a medusa rarely backs down from a conflict even when cornered. Many adventurers who thought themselves readied to resist the effects of a medusa's gaze have nevertheless fallen to a medusa, as these creatures are also often deadly archers able to riddle their foes with venom-coated arrows from a distance. Still, a medusa may barter for their life if no alternatives remain, and the secrets carried by these powerful villains often make it more than worth sparing the monster's life.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖精之火（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description: All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞动之光 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description: You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Chain Shirt.name: 链衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description: Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Crimson Fulcrum Lens.name: 绯红支点晶镜 Crimson Fulcrum Lens
Crimson Fulcrum Lens.description:
This concave lens has a drifting crimson cloud resembling slowly swirling blood within it. While you have the Crimson Fulcrum Lens invested, you seethe with malevolent fury you can barely contain. You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects and a +2 item bonus to your melee Strike damage (this increases to a +4 item bonus to damage if the melee Strike is a jaws attack). You can also activate the lens in the following ways.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.ytqvHyF0oMKbo65P]{Effect: Crimson Fulcrum Lens}

Activate 2 Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You grasp the Crimson Fulcrum Lens in one hand and make a Strike that doesn't require that hand. The Strike deals an additional 1d8 precision damage (or 2d8 precision damage if you make a jaws Strike) and doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

Activate 2 Interact (attack, possession)

Effect While grasping the lens, make a melee spell attack roll with a modifier of [[/r 1d20+18]]{+18}. On a hit, you force the splinter of Nhimbaloth's essence from the lens to possess the target. You're no longer invested in the lens, and the target gains the benefits as though it had invested the lens but can't activate the lens's other abilities. This effect is permanent, but it can be ended by any effect that removes a possession effect. The lens doesn't have any magical abilities until the possession effect ends; when it does, the essence returns to the lens.

Eerie Flexibility.name: 怪异柔韧 Eerie Flexibility
Eerie Flexibility.description: Despite its size, the gug's multiple joints allow it to fit through tight spaces as if it were a Medium creature. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeezing}, it can move at its full Speed.

Furious Claws.name: 狂怒利爪 Furious Claws
Furious Claws.description: The gug makes up to four claw Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks all count toward the gug's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after the gug makes all its attacks.

Urthagul.publicNotes:
A gug's most horrid feature is its barrel-shaped head, which splits vertically to reveal numerous rows of sharp, yellow teeth and an open throat. Its eyes on either side of its head-jaw are small but keen. Bony ridges protect its eyes from the frantic flailing of its prey, as it prefers meals of raw and writhing meat over fungi and molds. It grips said prey with powerful arms that split at the elbow into a pair of forearms, giving it four clawed paws. These monstrous brutes are covered with shaggy black fur, often crusted with blood and gore.

Although gugs may seem bestial, they have keen and wicked intellects. Gugs lair far underground, but they sometimes come to the surface to hunt during dark nights, either alone or in small groups. As they possess voracious appetites, most gugs consume the creatures they catch, but some instead kidnap their victims and retreat below the surface, leaving only a lingering stench and odd, clawed paw-prints. Victims are taken to rancid lairs marked with strange runes and sacrificed to the gugs' wicked gods of blood, darkness, and nightmares. Dire rumors tell of lightless gug cities made of titanic blocks of stone far underground, where powerful gug leaders preach their vile doctrines to mobs of howling gugs.

Gugs have a strange relationship with ghouls, which seems to date from their shared origin in a distant subterranean world. Gugs live in fear of ghouls, despite towering over them; however, this strange fear doesn't apply to ghasts, whom gugs consume as voraciously as they do other creatures.

Gugs stand 16 feet tall and weigh 2,000 pounds, although they have an eerie, graceful gait that belies their immense size. Their light step and ability to squeeze through very small crannies makes gugs common bogeymen in tales of strange disappearances or bloody massacres.

Some particularly bloodthirsty gugs gain awful powers as gifts from their eldritch patrons. These monsters are known as savants, are never less than 12th level in power, and gain several occult innate spells. Though each savant's precise mix of spells varies, normally, these spells grant invisibility, offer power to manipulate and change rock, or invoke awful and destructive energies upon living flesh.

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能内在法术 Occult Innate Spells

Feeblemind.name: 弱智术 Feeblemind
Feeblemind.description:
You drastically reduce the target's mental faculties. The target must attempt a Will save. The effects of this curse can be removed only through remove curse or another effect that targets curses.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The target's intellect is permanently reduced below that of an animal, and it treats its Charisma, Intelligence, and Wisdom modifiers as -5. It loses all class abilities that require mental faculties, including all spellcasting. If the target is a PC, they become an NPC under the GM's control.

True Seeing.name: 真视术 True Seeing
True Seeing.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion or transmutation in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Confusion.name: 困惑 Confusion
Confusion.description:
You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Bind Undead.name: 束缚不死生物 Bind Undead
Bind Undead.description:
With a word of power, you seize control of the target. It gains the minion trait. If you or an ally uses any hostile actions against the target, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rVkUzqS4rpZp9LS3]{Spell Effect: Bind Undead}

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Create Undead.name: 唤起死灵 Create Undead
Create Undead.description:
You transform the target into an undead creature with a level up to that allowed in Table 7-1. There are many versions of this ritual, each specific to a particular type of undead (one ritual for all zombies, one for skeletons, one for ghouls, and so on), and the rituals that create rare undead are also rare. Some forms of undead, such as liches, form using their own unique methods and can't be created with a version of create undead.

Table 7-1: Creatures Creation Rituals

Creature Level Spell Rank Required Cost
-1 or 0 2 15 gp
1 2 60 gp
2 3 105 gp
3 3 180 gp
4 4 300 gp
5 4 480 gp
6 5 750 gp
7 5 1,080 gp
8 6 1,500 gp
9 6 2,100 gp
10 7 3,000 gp
11 7 4,200 gp
12 8 6,000 gp
13 8 9,000 gp
14 9 13,500 gp
15 9 19,500 gp
16 10 30,000 gp
17 10 45,000 gp

Critical Success The target becomes an undead creature of the appropriate type. If it's at least 4 levels lower than you, you can make it a minion. This gives it the minion trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you command it, and commanding it is a single action that has the auditory and concentrate traits. You can have a maximum of four minions under your control. If it's intelligent and doesn't become a minion, the undead is helpful to you for awakening it, though it's still a horrid and evil creature. If it's unintelligent and doesn't become a minion, you can give it one simple command. It pursues that goal single-mindedly, ignoring any of your subsequent commands.

Success As critical success, except an intelligent undead that doesn't become your minion is only friendly to you, and an unintelligent undead that doesn't become your minion leaves you alone unless you attack it. It marauds the local area rather than following your command.

Failure You fail to create the undead.

Critical Failure You create the undead, but its soul, tortured by your foul necromancy, is full of nothing but hatred for you. It attempts to destroy you.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, verbal, somatic) You disperse void energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对魔法豁免+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Spell Deflection.name: 法术偏转 Spell Deflection
Spell Deflection.description:
A spellcaster who targets a devourer with a mental spell, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hVU9msO9yGkxKZ3J]{Divine Wrath}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PHVHBbdHeQRfjLmE]{Spirit Blast}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ht35SDf9PDStJfoC]{Spirit Song} can attempt a counteract check to free a soul the devourer has trapped with Devour Soul. If this counteract attempt succeeds, the trapped soul is released (though the creature remains dead), and the devourer can't use any soul charges from that creature.

Devourers are otherwise immune to these spells.

Devour Soul.name: {'zh': '灵魂', 'count': 1, 'sources': ['B_triple_bold'], 'examples': ['Data:Items-Soulfeeding Mask.json'], 'alternatives': None} Devour Soul
Devour Soul.description:
The devourer touches a creature within reach, dealing @Damage[8d6[void]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:31|basic] save). If a creature is slain by this attack, its soul becomes trapped within the devourer. While its soul is trapped, a creature can't be resurrected except by powerful magic such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} spell. Destroying the devourer or successfully counteracting Devour Soul (see spell deflection) releases the soul. The devourer can hold only one soul at a time.

A soul has 5 soul charges per level of the originating creature (see the soul spells ability below). The devourer can expend these charges to cast spells. If the soul is freed and the creature returns to life, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} for every 5 soul charges expended. If reduced to 0 soul charges, the soul is consumed and can be restored to life only by powerful magic such as wish.

Drain Life.name: 汲取生命 Drain Life
Drain Life.description: When the devourer damages a living creature with its claw Strike, the devourer gains 10 temporary Hit Points and the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Further damage dealt by the devourer increases the condition value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

Soul Spells.name: 灵魂法术 Soul Spells
Soul Spells.description: A devourer casts occult innate spells, but to do so it must expend a number of soul charges equal to the spell's rank (similar to casting a spell using charges from a staff). It can heighten any spell to a maximum of 6th level by expending more charges as it Casts the Spell. When encountered, a devourer typically has one trapped soul with 10 soul charges.

Beluthus.publicNotes: When fiends and powerful evil spellcasters are lost beyond the farthest reaches of the multiverse, they sometimes return as horrific undead called devourers that consume the souls of the living to fuel their arcane machinations. Their bodies are ruined and rebuilt, hollow and twisted, even as their minds undergo a spiritual transformation. They gain the ability to bind other souls to their own and drain their essence for magical power, yet can never be sated in their pursuit of it. Seething masses of distorted ghostly shapes surge within their hollow rib cages-manifestations of the devourers' most recently consumed souls.
Beluthus.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Caliddo Haruvex.name: Caliddo Haruvex

Composite Longbow.name: 复合长弓 Composite Longbow
Composite Longbow.description: This projectile weapon is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Like all longbows, its great size also increases the bow's range and power. You must use two hands to fire it, and it cannot be used while mounted. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a longbow, such as Erastil's favored weapon, it also applies to composite longbows unless otherwise stated.

Greatsword.name: 巨剑 Greatsword
Greatsword.description: This immense two-handed sword is nearly as tall as its wielder. Its lower blade is often somewhat dulled to allow it to be gripped for extra leverage in close-quarter fights.

Full Plate.name: 全身甲 Full Plate
Full Plate.description: Plate mail consists of interlocking plates that encase nearly the entire body in a carapace of steel. It is costly and heavy, and the wearer often requires help to don it correctly, but it provides some of the best defense armor can supply. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zBYEU9E7034ENCmh]{Padded Armor} and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ix2vicchE79d6Cl3]{gauntlets}.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description: These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Rejuvenation.name: {'zh': '你拥有复生', 'count': 1, 'sources': ['D_paren_ZHopenEN'], 'examples': ['支点镜片/乌木支点镜片'], 'alternatives': {'如复生': 1}} Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
When a graveknight is destroyed, its armor rebuilds its body over the course of [[/gmr 1d10 #days]]{1d10 days}-or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating its armor (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

Sacrilegious Aura.name: 亵渎灵光 Sacrilegious Aura
Sacrilegious Aura.description: 30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, the graveknight automatically attempts to counteract it, with a counteract modifier of [[/r 1d20+17 #Counteract]]{+17}.

Devastating Blast.name: 毁灭爆震 Devastating Blast
Devastating Blast.description:
The graveknight unleashes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy. Creatures in the area take @Damage[6d12[cold]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save).

The graveknight can use this ability once every [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]]{1d4 rounds}.

Graveknight's Curse.name: 死墓骑士诅咒 Graveknight's Curse
Graveknight's Curse.description:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour.

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:33] save

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}, the creature's Speed is reduced by 10, and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.6rnB7nK6J6zF4vea]{Effect: Graveknight's Curse}

Phantom Mount.name: 魅影坐骑 Phantom Mount
Phantom Mount.description:
HP 58; AC 27, Fort +17, Ref +15, Will +14

The graveknight summons a supernatural mount as per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{Marvelous Mount}, heightened to a level equal to half the graveknight's level.

Unlike phantom steed, the steed's AC and saving throw bonuses are all 4 lower than the graveknight's, and the steed has one-third the graveknight's Hit Points (rounded down).

If the steed is destroyed, the graveknight must wait 1 hour before using this ability again.

Weapon Master.name: 武器大师 Weapon Master
Weapon Master.description: The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.

Caliddo Haruvex.publicNotes: Graveknights are undead warriors granted unlife by a cursed suit of armor.

Shrine Corpselight.name: Shrine Corpselight

Darkvision.name: {'zh': '黑暗视觉', 'count': 7, 'sources': ['D_paren_ZHopenEN'], 'examples': ['《魔法之秘》2024年秋季勘误', '术语索引', '特殊魔宠（2e）'], 'alternatives': None} Darkvision

Corpse Sense (Precise) 30 feet.name: 尸感（精确）30尺 Corpse Sense (Precise) 30 feet
Corpse Sense (Precise) 30 feet.description: A corpselight can sense dead bodies within range. This is a precise sense that functions through solid barriers less than 5 feet thick.

Negative Healing.name: {'zh': '死生物或者具有负能量治疗', 'count': 1, 'sources': ['D_paren_ZHopenEN'], 'examples': ['正性调和'], 'alternatives': {'例如具有负能量治疗': 1}} Negative Healing

Sunlight Powerlessness.name: 阳光无力 Sunlight Powerlessness
Sunlight Powerlessness.description: A corpselight exposed to sunlight is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and cannot Claim a Corpse.

Wisp Form.name: 鬼火形态 Wisp Form
Wisp Form.description:
When a corpselight is reduced to 0 Hit Points while merged with a corpse, it is instead reduced to 1 Hit Point as the corpse collapses to the ground and the corpselight emerges in its wisp form.

While in wisp form, a corpselight is Tiny and can take no actions other than Claim Corpse or Fly.

A corpselight that starts its turn in wisp form must attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:16|immutable:true] at the end of its turn; if it fails, it loses 1 Hit Point. A corpselight reduced to 0 Hit Points while in wisp form is destroyed.

Claim Corpse.name: 夺取尸体 Claim Corpse
Claim Corpse.description:
Prerequisites The corpselight is in wisp form and is adjacent to a Medium or Small corpse that hasn't been claimed by a corpselight in the past 24 hours

Effect The corpselight merges with the corpse, causes the corpse to Stand, and regains [[/r 3d6[healing]]]{3d6 Hit Points}.

@UUID[Item.xkt9CKO2VR32gAYf]{Effect: Claim Corpse - Flesh}

@UUID[Item.qxNwICP84dBEsuS4]{Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal}

Death Light.name: 死亡之光 Death Light
Death Light.description:
Prerequisites The corpselight is in a corpse

Effect The corpselight emits a sickly blue beam of light from its mouth and eyes in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20]. All living creatures in this area must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:18|traits:damaging-effect] saving throw. If at least 1 creature fails its save, the corpselight regains [[/r 2d6[healing]]]{2d6 Hit Points}, gaining any that exceed its maximum as temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

The corpselight can't use again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Death Light]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes [[/r 1d6[negative]]] damage.

Failure The creature takes [[/r 2d6[negative]]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes [[/r 4d6[negative]]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal.name: 效果：夺取尸体——骸骨 Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal

Shrine Corpselight.publicNotes: A will-o'-wisp that starves to death might rise as a cold, blue, glowing sphere of spongy wetness-a corpselight. A corpselight instinctively seeks out a host corpse to dwell within, as its physical form quickly deteriorates if not hidden within a dead creature.

Chain Shirt.name: 链衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description: Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Portrait of Volluk Azrinae.name: 沃鲁克·阿兹里奈的肖像 Portrait of Volluk Azrinae
Portrait of Volluk Azrinae.description: This framed portrait captures the drow's beauty as well as his imperious, vain smirk. His name appears on a tiny gold plaque at the portrait's base.

Gorul Vetters.name: Gorul Vetters

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description: The prisoner does an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Surprise Attack.name: {'zh': '该生物获得盗贼的突袭攻击', 'count': 1, 'sources': ['D_paren_ZHopenEN'], 'examples': ['主题模板'], 'alternatives': {'突袭打击': 1, '突然袭击': 1}} Surprise Attack
Surprise Attack.description: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the prisoner.

You're Next.name: 你是下一个 You're Next
You're Next.description:
Trigger The prisoner reduces a creature to 0 hit points.

Effect The prisoner attempts an Intimidation check with a +2 circumstance bonus to [[/act demoralize options=youre-next]] a single creature it can see and that can see them.

Gorul Vetters.publicNotes:
Most who end up in a jail, dungeon, or prison are just biding their time until their imprisonment ends, trying to find ways to make it through interminable days of boredom and deprivation. Some, however, may use their time on the inside to strengthen their criminal connections. Using force and intimidation to gain status among other prisoners, they create makeshift weapons to take down their enemies and give them an edge if escape becomes possible. Even for prisoners who don't become involved in the world of prison politics, learning to stand up for themselves and projecting an air of toughness can become essential for survival in a place where people have little left to lose.

Unfortunately, every society has people living on its fringes. While good communities work to grant aid and respite to their downtrodden, sometimes-due to economic downturn, famine, or war-the ranks of the less fortunate exceed the community's capacity to support them. In heartless neutral and evil societies, poverty is seen as an inevitability that can never be truly eradicated, or even worse, as a tool to be manipulated for political gain.

Crystal Sense.description: This character can sense crystals or gems within 60 feet as if using imprecise scent, with a range of 60 feet.

Pharasma's Favor.name: 法勒斯玛的恩典 Pharasma's Favor
Pharasma's Favor.description: Pharasma grants a hero who destroys Borbo's soul gem a favor in the form of a momentary, prophetic glimpse of their fate. This allows that hero to gain a +2 status bonus to a single check, which they can apply even after they determine the check's result. The hero has 1 month to use this boon.

Defaced Iron Key.name: 毁损铁钥匙 Defaced Iron Key
Defaced Iron Key.description: This iron key once bore a symbol of Aroden, but has been defaced.

Four-pronged Key.name: 四叉钥匙 Four-pronged Key

Round Key.description: This unusual key has a round shaft tipped with several teeth of varying length.

Rusted Ring of Keys.name: 锈蚀钥匙环 Rusted Ring of Keys
Rusted Ring of Keys.description: Four of the keys on this ring are rusted beyond repair, but two are made of bronze and remain good condition.

Morningstar.name: 晨星锤 Morningstar
Morningstar.description: This weapon has a short shaft ending in a metal ball studded with spikes.

Valuable Parts.name: 珍贵零件 Valuable Parts
Valuable Parts.description: A collection of rare metals and delicate gears.

Black Onyx Gemstone.name: 黑色玛瑙宝石 Black Onyx Gemstone

Incomplete Soulbound Doll.name: 未完成的灵魂绑定玩偶 Incomplete Soulbound Doll
Incomplete Soulbound Doll.description: This unfinished soulbound doll resembles an armless, legless goblin.

Sword Cane.name: 剑杖 Sword Cane
Sword Cane.description: This slender, rapier-like sword is concealed within a wooden or metal cane that serves as a sheath, making it an inconspicuous weapon easy to slip past inspections or into high-society events. A sword cane is typically 4 feet long when sheathed, and its hilt is usually capped with a wooden or metal decoration.

Warhammer.name: 战锤 Warhammer
Warhammer.description: This weapon has a wooden shaft ending in a large, heavy metal head. Thehead of the hammer might be single‑sided or double‑sided, but it's always capable of delivering powerful bludgeoning blows.

Hatchet.name: {'zh': '短柄斧', 'count': 1, 'sources': ['D_paren_ZHopenEN'], 'examples': ['Data:Creatures-Ice Troll.json'], 'alternatives': None} Hatchet
Hatchet.description: This small axe can be used in close combat or thrown.

Pick.name: 十字镐 Pick
Pick.description: A pick designed solely for combat has a sturdy wooden shaft and a heavy, pointed head to deliver devastating blows.

Valuable Books.name: 贵重书籍 Valuable Books
Valuable Books.description: Morlibint of @UUID[JournalEntry.PrAuOqj2BsexgBgU.JournalEntryPage.0SO6cXvfRTtHZM6m]{Odd Stories} will pay the heroes for any especially rare or interesting tomes. He will pay five gold for each Bulk of books recovered from the Abomination Vaults. Rooms which contain such books will list how many bulk of books can be salvaged from them.

Wand of Quench.name: 熄灭魔杖 Wand of Quench
Wand of Quench.description:
@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.02J0rDTk37KN2sjt]

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated level.

Craft Requirements Supply a listed-level casting of the spell.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Whip.name: 鞭子 Whip
Whip.description: This long strand of thick leather, often braided, delivers a painful but nonlethal slash at a distance, usually accompanied by a distinctive cracking sound.

Composite Shortbow.name: 复合短弓 Composite Shortbow
Composite Shortbow.description: This shortbow is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Its compact size and power make it a favorite of mounted archers. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a shortbow, it also applies to composite shortbows unless otherwise stated.

Old Law Whiskey.name: 古老法则威士忌 Old Law Whiskey
Old Law Whiskey.description: This long-forgotten bottle of whiskey was found hidden in a pebble-covered niche of the Smuggler's Refuge.

Tamchal Chakram.name: 塔姆查尔掷环 Tamchal Chakram
Tamchal Chakram.description: These circular weapons are among the many strange weapons used by urdefhans. The sharp metal circle contains numerous protruding blades, while an angled central handle provides a decent grip that spins the weapon as it's thrown.

+1 Resilient Scale Mail.name: +1韧性鳞甲 +1 Resilient Scale Mail
+1 Resilient Scale Mail.description: Scale mail consists of many metal scales sewn onto a reinforced leather backing, often in the form of a long shirt that protects the torso, arms, and legs.

Leng Ruby.name: 冷原红宝石 Leng Ruby
Leng Ruby.description:
Activate: 10 minutes (envision);

Frequency: once per day;

Effect: You focus on the ruby, which casts a 5th-level @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate} spell that only targets Ysondkhelir.

Rare Silver Piece.name: 稀有银币 Rare Silver Piece

Ruby of Locate.name: 定位红宝石 Ruby of Locate
Ruby of Locate.description:
@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]

This ruby operates as an oddly-shaped magic wand, and contains a single spell.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated level.

Craft Requirements Supply a listed-level casting of the spell.

Seugathi Research Notes.name: 塞加斯研究笔记 Seugathi Research Notes
Seugathi Research Notes.description: The seugathi’s book contains several sketches of the shanrigol behemoth and notes in Aklo about its nature (it includes parts of, and therefore derives abilities from, driders and urdefhans), its weakness to positive energy, and that it’s kept docile in the arena by a steady diet of failed experiments. More than just a text about one specific monster, this book contains several insights of general applicability to other creatures. It’s worth 25 gp to a collector of rare tomes, such as Morlibint.

Velvet Curtain.name: 天鹅绒窗帘 Velvet Curtain
Velvet Curtain.description: The velvet curtain is in very good condition and worth 10 gp, although it weighs 5 Bulk and smells vaguely of xulgath stink.

Scroll of Dream Message.name: 梦境信息卷轴 Scroll of Dream Message
Scroll of Dream Message.description:
@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.yM3KTTSAIHhyuP14]

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Game Board.description: This game board is incomplete, but inlaid with semiprecious stones.

Drow Harrow Deck.description:
Used by gamblers and seers alike, this deck of cards comes in several varieties.

Fine harrow decks are made from a variety of materials, such as high-quality paper, woods, bone, ivory, or metal.

Drow Trade Goods.name: 黑暗精灵贸易商品 Drow Trade Goods
Drow Trade Goods.description: These trade goods include spices, dried fungus, and cloth that are all uncommon on the surface.

Ruby Idol.name: 红宝石神像 Ruby Idol
Ruby Idol.description: This ruby idol depicts the evil god Mazmezz.

Change Shape.name: {'zh': '变身', 'count': 1, 'sources': ['A_title_field'], 'examples': ['狐妖族裔'], 'alternatives': None} Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
This effect is intended to be used when @UUID[Actor.EN3mp0sVObP8ou3p]{Jaul Mezmin} uses his @UUID[Actor.EN3mp0sVObP8ou3p.Item.C2q1zvPuwqgQMvwX]{Change Shape} action. It automates the following effects:

  • Adjusts his token artwork to fit the form he chooses
  • In wolf form it modifies his base speed to 40
  • In wolf form it adds a note to his jaws attack as a reminder to use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{Knockdown}. 

As a reminder, changing shape also modifies Jaul's strikes. The attacks listed on his character sheet assume that he is in his Hybrid form. If he is another form, he may have access to different attacks, as explained in his Change Shape action.

Human:

  • Jaul cannot use his Jaws or Claw attacks. Instead, his unarmed attacks are Fist attacks.

Wolf:

  • His Jaw attacks gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{Knockdown}. He cannot use weapons.

Chapter Synopses.name: Chapter Synopses
Chapter Synopses.text:
升级

英雄们从1级开始（如果他们游玩过探索者入门宝盒冒险，则从2级开始）。

里程碑：英雄们在清除大多数铁拳灯废墟（包括灯塔穹顶）后，升至2级（或保持2级）。

第一章：

雾中之光

作者：詹姆斯·雅各布斯

薇林·希文希怀疑铁拳灯废墟中潜藏着危险，请英雄们前往调查废墟及其奇特的灯塔。

升级

英雄们应在"奥塔里的死潮"事件前达到2级。

里程碑：击败幽灵女王莫洛克后升至3级。

第二章：

被遗忘的地下城

作者：詹姆斯·雅各布斯

铁拳灯的阴森光束激活了奥塔里墓地中的亡灵，英雄们必须协助平息亡灵暴动并返回地下城。

升级

英雄们应在进入图书馆时达到3级。

里程碑：击败腐疮圣教团后升至4级。

第三章：

腐疮圣教团

作者：詹姆斯·雅各布斯

英雄们探索一座广阔图书馆，如今那里住着一群自称"腐疮圣教团"的博学而阴险的食尸鬼。

升级

英雄们应在进入贝尔科拉的静地时达到4级。

里程碑：与奥塔里的幽灵对话后升至5级。

第四章：

亡者长梦

作者：詹姆斯·雅各布斯

在英雄们遭遇奥塔里·伊尔瓦什提的幽灵后，他们收到了一个关于憎恶密窟更深处所藏危险的严峻警告。

升级

英雄们应在处理城镇盗窃和梦境操控事件前达到5级。

里程碑：清除竞技场层的大部分区域后升至6级。

第五章：

深入训练场

作者：瓦内萨·霍斯金斯

英雄们从奥塔里创始人处取回四件图腾以进入更深层地下城，并遇到与地下城有着出乎意料联系的城镇居民。

升级

英雄们应在进入实验室层时达到6级。

里程碑：击败贾法基和塞加斯后升至7级。

第六章：

血肉实验

作者：瓦内萨·霍斯金斯

在古老的炼金实验室中，英雄们可以挫败一个塞加斯的阴谋。

升级

英雄们应在进入监狱层时达到7级。

里程碑：处理好乌雷维安的事务后升至8级。

第七章：

灵魂守卫

作者：瓦内萨·霍斯金斯

一个名叫乌雷维安的契约魔鬼必须履行一份数百年前的协议，但英雄们或许可以与魔鬼谈条件来拯救城镇。

升级

英雄们应在进入农场层时达到8级。

里程碑：清除农场层的大部分区域后升至9级。

第八章：

腐朽花园

作者：斯蒂芬·拉德尼-麦克法兰

英雄们遭遇一个奇异的卡里格尼教派和一群亡灵诺姆的密会。

升级

英雄们应在进入猎场层时达到9级。

里程碑：进入尼姆巴洛斯之门后升至10级。

第九章：

狩猎中

作者：斯蒂芬·拉德尼-麦克法兰

在广阔的猎场层中，英雄们可以发现击败贝尔科拉所需的秘密，并找到所需的支点晶镜。

升级

英雄们应在进入神殿层时达到10级。

里程碑：击败贝尔科拉后（或许是就在击败前）升至11级。

第十章：

引出凶目

作者：斯蒂芬·拉德尼-麦克法兰

英雄们探索外层神祇尼姆巴洛斯的古老神殿，并一劳永逸地对贝尔科拉发起终极战斗！

Getting Started.name: Getting Started
Getting Started.text:
本模组附带了大量日志条目，提供详细的房间描述、NPC传记及其他工具。我们会尽可能在日志本身中链接相关条目，以便您随时获取有用信息。如果您决定开展憎恶密窟冒险路线，以下是一些可以先阅读的有用日志！

规划你的游戏

本日志包含多个页面，提供有用素材，帮助您决定如何开始规划并最终主持您的战役。

您可以在@UUID[.uGgoAibjz5qhnqmL]{升级}中阅读建议的升级规则，并浏览@UUID[.8aIgvvxLjsYxB1LS]{章节概要}部分，快速了解冒险事件的梗概。

@UUID[.qkriih9KjZ8YA9za]{探索}、@UUID[.mH6Z1rs7XY2Agp9q]{遭遇战}和@UUID[.yJnbkL33UerrQWr9]{使用音频}页面包含如何阅读日志及使用其中信息的建议。

准备好深入冒险时，请前往@UUID[JournalEntry.3T1M395V6J75OsEp.JournalEntryPage.8Jl0TWoH4iUJzJxK]{开始冒险}以进入第一章：@UUID[JournalEntry.3T1M395V6J75OsEp.JournalEntryPage.x2NtFguDC8zATVxs]{雾中之光}！

冒险工具箱

如果您想进一步了解奥塔里的过去和铁拳灯的历史，@UUID[JournalEntry.YbOS6pQRxoWI0Q56]{战役背景}手册包含重要日期与事件的时间线，以及对当地历史与事件的详细介绍。

奥塔里今日的样貌最好通过@UUID[JournalEntry.YbOS6pQRxoWI0Q56.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{奥塔里简介}来了解，而@UUID[JournalEntry.PrAuOqj2BsexgBgU]{奥塔里地点}日志则描述了城镇中每个主要地点，以及可在那里找到的NPC信息。

您还可以在@UUID[JournalEntry.DQepDGIcXuhkYOuU]{角色传记}日志中阅读故事中最重要的角色，以充实其动机与过去。

使用本内容

@UUID[.mH6Z1rs7XY2Agp9q]{遭遇战} @UUID[.qkriih9KjZ8YA9za]{探索} @UUID[.N725007XsfScJ6hd]{宝藏} @UUID[.yJnbkL33UerrQWr9]{使用音频}

如果您看到像这样的提示框，意味着我们有关于如何最好地利用模组及其内容的建议。标题中会包含相关日志文章、物品等的链接。例如，此处列出的链接继续解释了本说明！点击每个链接，了解您在接下来日志中会看到的不同类型提示框。

深入冒险

我们已经介绍了涵盖战役背景信息和模组使用一般建议的日志。那么最后一组日志，便是冒险本身。

@UUID[JournalEntry.3T1M395V6J75OsEp]{憎恶密窟}日志包含每个章节所有关键故事与情节事件，按时间顺序排列。此外，地下城的每一层都有专属日志条目，包含逐房间的描述，并详细说明玩家可能在其中发现的每个生物、事件或物品。这些均可在侧边栏日志标签的"地点"文件夹中找到，那里还以类似方式介绍了奥塔里城镇本身，涵盖城镇中的主要地标、商店及角色。

内容警告：

虽然憎恶密窟包含典型的探索者行动与冒险，但它也呈现了自杀、残障歧视、身体恐怖和人体实验等主题。在开始之前，请了解玩家同意（包括游戏主持人）对于所有人安全愉快的游戏体验至关重要。您应在开始前与玩家讨论，并根据需要修改描述或场景。

Advancement.name: Advancement
Advancement.text:
来自入门宝盒

如果您以探索者入门宝盒及"奥塔里的威胁"冒险作为英雄职业生涯的起点，您的英雄已经了解奥塔里，并且已经是2级！您无需对本冒险做任何调整，2级角色可以毫无问题地开始冒险。在他们充分清除上方两层地下城的危险之前，不要允许他们升至3级。

使用经验值

虽然@UUID[JournalEntry.YbOS6pQRxoWI0Q56.JournalEntryPage.RBY8Uu8FDdAjmE4K]{憎恶密窟}的每一层都是基于特定角色等级的英雄小队而设计的，但每一层的遭遇战都足够让小队升级。大型地下城爬行的乐趣之一就是探索每一个角落，面对所有遭遇战的小队可能在冒险路线结束前就获得足够的经验值升至更高等级——这没问题！一些后期遭遇战对高等级小队仍然构成足够的挑战，即使英雄们偶尔需要撤退、休息和恢复。

地下城提供了大量自由探索空间，尤其是在中间层级。让玩家判断其角色是否超出能力范围，并在情况需要时撤退（或逃跑！）。当英雄面对比当前等级预期更难的挑战时，他们获得更多经验值；面对更简单的挑战时，获得较少经验值。这使他们的进度大致保持在相同轨道上。话虽如此，如果您想要节奏更慢的游戏，憎恶密窟也适合使用慢速升级速度（探索者核心规则书第509页）。

使用里程碑

基于故事的进度对于大型地下城爬行可能会比较棘手，因为英雄们可以通过多条路线在各层之间移动。如果您偏好基于故事的进度，而不是仅因为英雄们迅速到达较低层级就自动允许他们升级，可以考虑要求他们完成特定里程碑才能升级，详细内容请参见@UUID[.8aIgvvxLjsYxB1LS]{章节概要}中的"升级"部分。

Exploration.name: Exploration
Exploration.text:
您应记录玩家让其角色在探索时通常所做的事情。您可以在探索者核心规则书中找到探索活动列表，或者在行动标签页中筛选exploration（探索）特征来使用@Compendium[pf2e.pf2e-macros.s2sa8lo9dcIA6UGe]{规则书浏览器}——或者，您也可以直接询问每位玩家描述其角色的行动，并决定哪种探索活动最符合其描述。

探索提示框

某些效果根据英雄是否在调查、搜索或进行其他探索活动而列于房间描述中。这些效果由特殊提示框标注，如下例所示。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

搜索房间

英雄在搜索房间时进行@Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{感知}检定成功，便能发现北墙挂毯后面的一扇秘密门。

调查马赛克

进行@Check[type:society|dc:20|traits:action:decipher-writing]{社会}检定以@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{解读文字}，可发现北墙上的神秘文字是一句古老的精灵语格言。

行动

在探索提示框中，标题里会列出需要关注的相关行动。例如在本例中，我们知道如果有任何玩家在@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}或@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}，他们可能会获得额外信息。这是最常见的两种探索活动，但其他活动，如@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{侦察}或@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{避免注意}也会很有用。当然，即使玩家没有进行列出的特定探索活动，您也可以自由地为玩家提供信息、秘密门或宝藏！

正如您可能已经注意到的，这些链接除了作为需要关注哪些活动的参考，您也可以点击这些链接查看该探索活动的完整规则文本。

检定

有时这些探索活动需要掷骰，如上一节所示。在整个冒险中，大多数技能检定和豁免检定将以此格式呈现。通过按下按钮旁的对话框图标，您可以将其打印到聊天框，让玩家只需点击（选中其代币！）即可进行检定。这完全是可选的，但可以方便地一眼看出成功等级。

但有时，只要角色花时间搜索房间，就能找到某些东西，无需掷骰。

Encounters.name: Encounters
Encounters.text:
在探索憎恶密窟时，英雄们将不可避免地遭遇必须被击败才能拯救奥塔里——乃至阿布萨洛姆本身的敌人！当他们遭遇敌人时，就进入了遭遇战。

遭遇战提示框

在阅读区域描述时，您经常会遇到包含可能引发战斗的生物的房间。在那些地方，像这样的遭遇战提示框将包含您运行遭遇战所需的所有信息。

当然，并非每场遭遇战都必须以战斗告终。许多遭遇战是可选的，或为英雄提供外交机会。仅仅因为它在这些提示框中，并不意味着生物不能被说服，甚至最终成为盟友！

遭遇战

中等威胁 2级

@Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.ZMr28tFTA5NUcBTi]{网伏者} @Compendium[pf2e.hazards.Or0jjL8xS3GyiMq0]{网伏者套索（2）}

76 经验值

一个令人恐惧的敌人潜伏着等待毫无防备的过路者。

网伏者很饥饿，但不鲁莽。如果它意识到英雄们太强大无法对付，它会逃跑。

危险

不只有蜘蛛需要担心——网伏者已经设置了两个套索来捕捉粗心的冒险者！

每次遭遇战涉及的生物都列在标题中以便快速访问，其代币已预先放置在地图上。标题还会告知您遭遇战是否涉及危险、凶灵或类似情况，以及遭遇战的威胁评级和经验值预算。请注意，虽然这两者通常相关，但在涉及简单危险或极弱敌人时，经验值预算有时会与预期略有不同！

正文包含生物战术或优先事项的描述，以及其他有用信息，如潜在的环境危险或宝藏。

奖励经验值

虽然我们为您提供了数字，但一如既往，您可以选择给予玩家遭遇战的总经验值、根据威胁等级给予特定数量，或者简单地使用@UUID[.uGgoAibjz5qhnqmL]{升级}日志中详述的里程碑升级方式。

Treasure.name: Treasure
Treasure.text:
在英雄们深入憎恶密窟时，他们可能会发掘出宝贵的财宝或强力的魔法物品。

原则上，玩家可以获得的所有宝藏都会在区域描述的日志条目中列出。通过@UUID[.mH6Z1rs7XY2Agp9q]{遭遇战}或@UUID[.qkriih9KjZ8YA9za]{探索}获得的物品通常可以在各自的提示框内找到，而其他类型的宝藏则会有自己的提示框，如下所示。

宝藏提示框

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.LJdbVTOZog39EEbi]{一把闪亮的长剑} @Actor[S8VDmNHzkFEmjWfL]{一只浸水的宝箱}

洞穴深处摆放着一堆闪闪发光的财宝！

分发物品

如您所见，我们可以用两种不同方式链接宝藏。直接链接到物品的链接（如上方的长剑）可以直接从日志拖拽到玩家的角色卡。在其他情况下，尤其是当一个地方有大量不同物品时，我们会提供战利品角色，如上方的浸水宝箱。这些角色的代币已默认隐藏地放置在场景中。它们可以包含多个物品，只需揭示代币，给予玩家这些物品就变得简单了。玩家可以打开战利品卡，直接从中拖拽物品到他们的物品栏。

金币作为宝藏

金币是唯一不会在日志中链接的宝藏形式。这是因为玩家已经有了一种方便的方式将金币添加到角色卡——通过物品栏中的"添加货币"功能。

修改宝藏

如果您计划修改玩家将找到的物品，或者想大概了解他们可能获得的物品种类，可以查看下方列表。这列出了每章的所有永久性和消耗性魔法物品，不包括仅用于交易的宝藏物品。当然，您的玩家可能找不到憎恶密窟提供的每一件宝藏！

Audio.name: Audio
Audio.text:
本冒险包含超过70个不同的播放列表，用于营造特定氛围、提供音频线索，或激励玩家勇往直前、光荣战斗。虽然播放列表已经过精心整理，尽可能直观易用，但与主持冒险的所有方面一样，准备工作至关重要。

为了给玩家提供最佳音频体验，了解您可以使用的播放列表和音效类型非常重要。

同时播放音乐和环境音

我们没有为一般战斗遭遇战提供预设的音乐或音景，但某些地图区域已预配置了特定的音乐氛围。这些内容可以通过将名称与区域的日志条目匹配来合理识别。虽然这些条目的命名不完全一致，但应该可以清楚地分辨出哪个是哪个。

大多数场景有几个关键音乐主题与环境音轨相结合，每个都经过精心平衡，设置为同时播放，以构建该区域的音景。

如果您发现音乐或音景变得重复，"所有楼层"播放列表文件夹包含可用于为区域带来不同感觉的音乐和环境音。

反复出现的主题

提供的播放列表包含并重复使用了一些反复出现的主题，让您为玩家建立听觉记忆。例如，每当场景涉及贝尔科拉·哈鲁维克斯、她的魔像之一，或她过去留下的特别强大痕迹时，播放列表将以"贝尔科拉警告"开始。在尼姆巴洛斯的本质产生过影响的地方，音频轨道"我们对空死说什么"可能已作为环境音源留在场景中——尽管音量够小，只有最细心的玩家才能注意到。在前四层中，沃鲁克的主题"蠕虫进行曲"（或"蠕虫华尔兹"）已被融入播放列表，以代表他在那个特定支线剧情中的参与。大量（但巧妙地）使用这类音轨将帮助在玩家最终面对其敌人的不可避免战斗中，当主题被使用时引发他们的反应。

环境音源

知识库：环境音

在整个冒险中，每个场景至少有两个预先放置的环境音源，通常以铁拳灯塔为中心。环境音源在玩家代币附近提供音频线索，GM在游戏前了解玩家将会听到哪些声音非常重要。在开始游戏前，花点时间通过检查环境音控件来熟悉玩家可能听到的声音。

您可以随时通过从音效层右键单击环境音源来停止其发出声音。

使用战斗音乐

虽然只为普通战斗遭遇战提供了少量战斗音频轨道，但也有一系列"重要遭遇战"音乐轨道可用于更严肃的战斗。虽然其中一些已为特定遭遇战选定，但我们鼓励您用现有工具创建自己的战斗音景。但请注意——由于上述反复主题的使用，对特定轨道的过度曝光可能对冒险的音频体验产生负面影响。在播放之前，始终了解您的玩家将听到什么（以及音量有多大）。

使用环境静默

少数几个关键地方使用了不包含音乐的播放列表，这是有意为之的。这些地方旨在为GM提供将静默作为危险信号的机会。为了最大化效果，建议您使用播放列表的暂停按钮，让玩家警觉即将到来的危险，或感受到被监视的感觉。

在憎恶密窟的深处，每个角落都可能潜藏危险，有时一个恰到好处的静默就足以让玩家考虑撤退。

Keys.name: Keys
Keys.text:
在整个冒险中，英雄们可能会找到可用于打开地下城各处门和锁的钥匙。您可以通过房间描述日志中链接的物品来追踪他们发现了哪些钥匙。但是，钥匙的描述不会告诉您它能打开哪扇门——只会告诉您在哪个房间找到的。这是因为您可能不想在英雄找到钥匙时立即向玩家透露它能打开哪扇门。

因此，我们将所有这些信息汇集在本页的一个地方。如果您愿意，也可以使用此手册来追踪英雄已经找到和尚未找到的钥匙。
